rule.rank: percentile rank = (scores below + half the ties) / population size; the population of an item is every stock holding a score on that item from its registered run (or its published memo)
rule.registered_run: the newest live card in the conveyor's trays whose run holds scores; dry, cancelled and control runs never enter
rule.boundaries: per item, the lowest score that earned each grade today; null where no score earned that grade
rule.comparison_set: the stocks analysed by the new approach (the Sets of Questions/Items approach)
